item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena finds four objects on her study table at home: an iron nail, a plastic ruler, a copper wire, and a wooden pencil. She wants to know which object is made of a magnetic material. Which method will correctly tell her this?

options.A: She should check which object looks hard and shiny, because all shiny objects are magnetic.
options.B: She should bring a magnet near each object and see which one is attracted towards the magnet.
options.C: She should drop each object in water and see which one sinks, because sinking objects are magnetic.
options.D: She should rub each object with a cloth and see which one becomes warm, because warm objects are magnetic.
